purpose: Draft D3T gate-census ledger (#290): the typed-provenance residual-obligation relation passes interface dependence, closure preservation, provenance separation, first-closure integrity, and continuation-profile boundary sufficiency, but fails phase-boundary sufficiency. D8c2 was not run and remains unpassed.

entries.claim: For two-origin open typed histories, the frozen D3T relation is interface-dependent (264 distinct continuation profiles over 1,536 length-3 bases; 33 over 27,496 length-4 bases), closure-preserving (0 closure failures among obligation-matching candidates; 12,096 + 8,736 admitted joins), provenance-separating (same aggregate data but different profile in 150/158 and 62/402 aggregate groups; same raw word but different provenance profile in 504/512 and 2,048/3,928 word groups), and first-closure-correct (0 earlier all-origin closures). The boundary record determines the continuation profile in both panels (0 boundary groups with multiple profiles out of 360 and 2,238), but does not determine the closure phase: 34/46 whole-history boundary groups at length 4 and 178/199 at length 6 contain both phases, and 1,368/2,112 (panel A) and 2,016/4,704 (panel B) extension groups are phase-ambiguous. Adding the extension origin schedule reduces panel-A ambiguity to 432 groups but does not eliminate it; the full extension word eliminates it.
entries.formal_scope: Finite two-origin typed histories over the 8-twist alphabet. Panel A: open base length 3, extension bound 3. Panel B: open base length 4, extension bound 2. Whole-history phase: closed two-origin histories of lengths 4 and 6. The relation uses net action, Pauli product, provenance, and typed first closure only. No diversity advantage, D8c2 result, physical phase identification, persistence, or holographic-dictionary claim.
entries.comparator: Exhaustive census in diversity_obligation.py and data/diversity_obligation_census.json; aggregate control keeps bases, extensions, openness, and first closure but ignores per-origin matching. Diagnostic controls add the extension origin schedule and the full extension word to the phase grouping.
entries.kill_condition: Any boundary group with multiple continuation profiles (D3T.5 failure), any admitted join not ZFA-closed, any earlier all-origin closure, or any failure to reproduce the stated counts from the frozen module and data. The phase ambiguity is itself the registered D3T.6 failure; it is not a reason to add a post-hoc field, weight, or tie-breaker.

registration.observable: Gate verdicts D3T.1-D3T.6 of Diversity_Obligation_D3T.md section 5: the set of distinct continuation profiles C_T(a) (D3T.1); is_zfa of every obligation-matching candidate join (D3T.2); profile differences within equal aggregate-data groups and equal raw-word groups (D3T.3); earlier all-origin ZFA prefixes (D3T.4); boundary-record groups with more than one continuation profile (D3T.5); boundary-record groups containing both closure phases (D3T.6).
registration.analysis_rule: Exhaustive enumeration of every two-origin provenance-typed history in the frozen panels; each gate is a Boolean verdict on exact integer counts, computed by the frozen relation R_T (section 3) with no weight, score or fitted parameter.
registration.uncertainty: none: exact integer enumeration of a finite space, no sampling and no floating point; reproducibility is checked by diversity_obligation.py --self-test and --run against data/diversity_obligation_census.json.
registration.rejection_rule: As frozen in section 5: D3T.1 fails if every base has the same profile; D3T.2 fails on any admitted join that is not ZFA-closed; D3T.3 fails if no aggregate or no word separation exists; D3T.4 fails on any earlier all-origin closure; D3T.5 fails on any boundary group with multiple profiles; D3T.6 fails if any boundary group contains both phases. A failed gate is recorded, not repaired by a post-hoc field, weight or tie-breaker.
registration.dataset_or_experiment: Computed census, no external data. Panel A: open base length 3, extension bound 3. Panel B: open base length 4, extension bound 2. Whole-history phase: closed two-origin histories of lengths 4 and 6. Output: data/diversity_obligation_census.json.
